external_entities.name: Developers
external_entities.description: People who push branches to the self-hosted git server and can manually start rebuilds of main.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server

external_entities.name: Public package registry
external_entities.description: Internet package registry reached during dependency resolution.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Dependency resolution reaches out to the public package registry on the internet

processes.name: Build runner
processes.description: Picks up merges, fetches source, resolves dependencies, produces container images, pushes images, calls the deploy controller, and can be manually used to rebuild main.
processes.source_excerpt: The build runner picks the merge up, fetches the source, resolves the dependency lockfile and produces a container image.
processes.notes: Any developer can log in to the build runner and kick off a rebuild of main by hand; that path does not require a merge and is not reviewed. The runner does not verify signatures on what it downloads.

processes.name: Deploy controller
processes.description: Maintains the current image SHA for the estate and responds to release queries from store servers.
processes.source_excerpt: The deploy controller runs on the corporate network and holds one record: which image sha the estate should be on.
processes.notes: The runner uses a shared build token to call the controller; the token is the same for every pipeline and has not been rotated since the pipeline was set up.

processes.name: Store server
processes.description: A small back-office server at each store that asks for the current release, pulls images, and restarts the till container when its image differs.
processes.source_excerpt: Every store server asks the deploy controller once a minute what the current release is
processes.notes: There are about 1,200 stores. Nobody has written down what a store server presents to the registry or what it presents to the controller.

processes.name: Till software
processes.description: Till software running as a container on each store server.
processes.source_excerpt: Each store has a small server in the back office running the till software as a container.

data_stores.name: Self-hosted git server
data_stores.description: Git server receiving developer branches and providing source and dependency lockfile content to the build runner.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server
data_stores.notes: Nobody has documented whether the git server encrypts what it stores.

data_stores.name: Image registry
data_stores.description: Registry storing finished container images tagged with commit SHAs and serving them to store servers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It pushes the finished image to our image registry, which is also in the build environment.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has documented whether the image registry encrypts what it stores. The registry allows the pull; nobody has written down what a store server presents to it.

data_flows.name: push branches
data_flows.description: Developers push branches to the self-hosted git server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server

data_flows.name: fetch source
data_flows.description: The build runner fetches source from the self-hosted git server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The build runner picks the merge up, fetches the source

data_flows.name: resolve dependencies
data_flows.description: The build runner reaches out to the public package registry while resolving dependencies.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Dependency resolution reaches out to the public package registry on the internet
data_flows.notes: The runner does not verify signatures on what it downloads.

data_flows.name: push image
data_flows.description: The build runner pushes the finished container image to the image registry.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It pushes the finished image to our image registry
data_flows.notes: Images are tagged with the commit sha.
data_flows.data_description: Finished container image tagged with a commit SHA

data_flows.name: set current release
data_flows.description: The build runner calls the deploy controller to make an image the current release.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When the image is pushed the runner calls the deploy controller and asks it to make that image the current release.
data_flows.notes: Authentication uses a shared build token that is the same for every pipeline and has not been rotated since the pipeline was set up.
data_flows.data_description: Image SHA and shared build token

data_flows.name: read current release
data_flows.description: Each store server asks the deploy controller for the current release.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every store server asks the deploy controller once a minute what the current release is
data_flows.notes: Nobody has written down what a store server presents to the controller.

data_flows.name: pull image
data_flows.description: A store server pulls the current container image from the image registry when its running image differs.
data_flows.source_excerpt: if it differs from what it is running it pulls that image from the registry
data_flows.notes: The registry allows the pull; nobody has written down what a store server presents to it.

data_flows.name: restart container
data_flows.description: The store server restarts the till software container after pulling a different image.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it pulls that image from the registry and restarts the container
data_flows.data_description: Container image and running till software

data_flows.name: rebuild main
data_flows.description: A developer logs in to the build runner and manually kicks off a rebuild of main.
data_flows.source_excerpt: any developer can log in to the build runner and kick off a rebuild of `main` by hand
data_flows.notes: This path does not require a merge and is not reviewed.

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: Corporate network containing the self-hosted git server and deploy controller.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The deploy controller runs on the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: Build environment
trust_boundaries.description: Separate build environment containing the build runner and image registry.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The runner lives in its own build environment, separate from the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: Store estate
trust_boundaries.description: The in-store estate containing the store servers and till software containers.

trust_boundaries.name: Retail WAN
trust_boundaries.description: WAN over which traffic between stores and the corporate network travels.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Traffic between the stores and the corporate network goes over the retail WAN.

trust_boundaries.name: Internet
trust_boundaries.description: Internet network hosting the public package registry.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the public package registry on the internet
